title: Economic Impact of British Rule in India

faqs.q: Under British rule, the era of one-way free trade for British citizens began with which legislation?

What share of the world economy did India account for at the beginning of the eighteenth century, according to historians?
faqs.e: This share fell to about 3 per cent by the time India became independent.
